note: Studio and infrastructure incidents are NOT executed by the CLI repair harness. They need a live stack (Railway services, the backup host, the Studio app) and are tracked here so the CLI dataset stays CLI-only.

incidents.description: Incident class: the backup watchdog stops reporting, so a missed backup goes unnoticed.
incidents.cliCounterpart: None. The CLI repair loop must never delete or modify backups (protected path 'backups').
